headline.text: L3 Truffle flavor pump faulted without alarm — *1.5 pallets* held on low mint intensity after second QA check.

summary: One active quality hold on L3 Truffle (low flavor intensity, hold 26-687). Two foreign-material findings: bolt recovered near L2 ML2 flow wrapper, heavy cream tote leaking at L1. L1 S1 drain backed up; environmental monitoring for Listeria and Salmonella completed before and after cleaning.

holds.title: Low mint flavor intensity on Truffle Line
holds.summary: Flavor pump faulted without triggering alarm; organoleptic check identified low mint intensity after line had been running normally — 1 full pallet plus 1 partial pallet placed on hold 26-687.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition under reference 26-687.

food_safety.title: Heavy cream tote leaking significantly
food_safety.summary: One tote of heavy cream reported leaking significantly; transfer to new tote requested to prevent contamination.
food_safety.status: Open — transfer requested, awaiting action from Jody Howse and Brandon Hernandez.

food_safety.title: Bolt found underneath FW exit belt on ML2
food_safety.summary: Operator found bolt under flow wrapper exit belt; maintenance inspected jaw assembly, no missing bolts identified — suspected leftover from 12g to 60g changeover.
food_safety.status: Resolved — bolt recovered, jaw assembly inspected with no missing hardware found.

quality.title: S4 temperature stack found at 120°F instead of 180°F
quality.summary: Temperature stack feeding Conbar pipework discovered off — 120°F instead of setpoint 180°F at start of shift.
quality.status: Resolved — temperature corrected, caramel quality verified and line continued.

quality.title: S4 flow-wrap packages coming out open
quality.summary: High number of open packages on S4 TG line; maintenance straightened folders, line paused for adjustment.

quality.title: S4 dimensional failures — 30% out of spec
quality.summary: High rejection rate at intervals; 70% correct dimensions, 30% oversized — operator suspects forming component misalignment; maintenance investigated.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance estimated 1 hour fix, tunnels 1 and 2 scrapped for level 2 clean, line fixed 15 min before 23:12 MT.

quality.title: S4 dry-texture caramel detected and removed
quality.summary: Very dry texture detected in candy starting from first pause; production removed affected pieces, viscosity and WA tests showed improved elasticity — line continued.
quality.status: Resolved — texture improved after temperature adjustments, line running normally.

sanitation.title: S1 drain backed up in production area
sanitation.summary: Drain overflow during cleaning; both S1 kitchen and marshmallow area draining simultaneously exceeded capacity — not a clog, volume issue.
sanitation.status: Resolved — environmental sponge samples collected for Listeria and Salmonella before and after cleaning per QA requirement; area cleaned with disposable mops.

sanitation.title: FFS seal jaw blade cleaning frequency insufficient
sanitation.summary: Maintenance had difficulty removing blade from seal jaw due to considerable burnt-on product buildup on snack-size pouch; once-per-shift cleaning now required.
sanitation.status: Open — cleaning frequency increased to once per shift when running snack-size pouch.

opportunities.text: Consider pre-shift temperature verification checklist for S4 stack feeding Conbar — stack found at 120°F instead of 180°F, contributing to dry-texture caramel issues.
Review label scanning procedure with packing teams — second LPN in two days used before scanning into RF Smart on FFS line.

Consider adding alarm functionality verification to flavor pump startup checklist — today's pump fault did not trigger the temper unit alarm, delaying detection of the mint flavor issue on Truffle Line.
Review equipment sensor handling in cleaning training — both TG3 and TG4 proximity sensors on ML4 damaged by cleaning team forcing them during removal.
